newsitem.title: USA: AT&T says Pa. panel endorses reseller rate.
newsitem.headline: AT&T says Pa. panel endorses reseller rate.

text.p: AT&T Corp said the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission endorsed allowing resellers of local telephone service a discount rate of 22.9 percent off retail local telephone service prices.
The action came at a commission hearing at which members provided a preliminary indication of their vote on a final order to be issued by December 1, AT&T said in a release.
In addition, AT&T said it is to receive a five percent reduction for gross receipts tax, as agreed by Bell Atlantic Corp.

AT&T said it agreed to supporting the 22.9 percent discount level during the arbitration process over terms for competitive local service offerings, though it believed a 28.2 percent discount was justified.
It said Bell Atlantic, the monopoly local service provider over most of Pennsylvania, had proposed a 14.56 percent discount.
AT&T said it hoped to begin providing local services in Pennsylvania in 1997.
